kubernetes.description: The kubernetes manager has no default file matching — without this, Renovate never reads k8s/*.yaml and the pinned image tag is never bumped.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once the release is 72h old. internalChecksFilter "none" opens the PR immediately with a pending renovate/stability-days check (the default "strict" would hide it until day 3), so there are 72h to review or close it. Releases with no registry timestamp never pass the age check and stay manual.
0.x minor bumps are breaking by semver — review those like majors.
Electron and CI-action updates don't change the container image, so their merge commits skip the automatic release (see version-bump.yml) instead of publishing an identical image.

Group the app's own image bump with nothing else so the PR is a clean version bump, and auto-merge it (once the PR's docker build check is green) so new releases roll into k8s/deployment.yaml without manual clicks.
